name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's career in motorsport security began unconventionally, starting as a systems engineer for high-speed train networks. His meticulous approach and expertise in complex security protocols caught the attention of RSC Motorsport, who were seeking to revamp their safety infrastructure. He joined RSC a decade ago and quickly rose through the ranks, implementing cutting-edge security measures that have significantly reduced incident rates. 

Tanaka-san believes in proactive security, using data analysis and predictive modeling to anticipate and neutralize potential threats. He is known for his rigorous attention to detail and his relentless pursuit of improvement, constantly seeking new technologies and strategies to enhance the team's safety and security. His focus is not merely on preventing incidents, but on creating a culture of safety awareness throughout the organization, making RSC Motorsport a benchmark for security in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium height, Kenji maintains a focused and alert demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn book on risk assessment methodologies.
Insists on starting every security briefing with a Zen proverb.
Has an uncanny ability to spot potential security flaws from seemingly innocuous details.
